mcqs.q: How many planetary boundaries did Rockstrom et al identify in 2009?
What does Frank's dependency theory argue?
options: Dependency theory is the same as Rostow's modernisation theory.
That LICs (periphery) are kept poor by exploitative trade relationships with HICs (core) — underdevelopment is actively produced by capitalism, not a stage that countries grow out of.
Dependency theory says LICs are poor because they depend too much on foreign aid.
GDP measures the total wealth of every individual in a country.

mcqs.q: Why is GDP per capita a poor measure of wellbeing?
options: Dependency theory is the same as Rostow's modernisation theory.
GDP measures the total wealth of every individual in a country.
A high GDP per capita means citizens are happy and well off.
GDP measures economic activity, not wellbeing. It ignores inequality, unpaid work, environmental damage and quality of life — high GDP can coexist with poor health, education or happiness.
It is the process of rain falling from clouds.
The combined loss of water from a surface through evaporation (from soil and water bodies) and transpiration (from plant leaves).
It is only water evaporating from puddles and lakes.
Dependency theory is the same as Rostow's modernisation theory.
